scientific_integrity: Full-domain proof is analytic; modular exact finite runs are auxiliary checks and not universal evidence. The placement and all-optimum necessity are proved using PBH and explicit eigenspaces.
scientific_limitations: Unit-weight fixed combinatorial Laplacian and independent coordinate inputs only; no claims for variable weights, arbitrary unequal cycle lengths or structural-robust controllability. The zero-forcing value is previously known. Specialist priority risk remains. No independent audit.
title: Exact dedicated-input controllability of Dutch windmill Laplacians below the zero-forcing threshold
